Backend: 14/14 pytests in test_design_memory.py PASS (auth, CRUD, whitelist drop of captions/video_id, key validation, recommend always-3 with ranks Best/Good/Alternative + stars 5/4/3, category inference burger/seafood/sports, memory bias elevates saved theme to Best Match, general fallback). Frontend: menu-item-picker + search + ArrowDown/Enter selection + clear ALL work. Saved-style banner correctly hidden without memory and correctly shown after PUT (with Use Saved Style / Start Fresh). TWO frontend integration bugs found: (1) clicking 'Use Saved Style' does NOT elevate the saved theme to Best Match in the top-3 cards (it stays in all-themes only); (2) clicking Download on Done step does NOT open the save-style-modal (learning loop is broken).

integration_issues.flow: Use Saved Style → Best Match elevation
integration_issues.issue: When user clicks data-testid='photo-flyer-use-saved-style' and proceeds to Review, the saved theme (burger_neon_diner) is NOT elevated to the Best Match position in cd-recs. Reason: chicken-wings-12 → category='sports' (50 pts) outweighs memory bias (+35 pts) in the backend scorer; cross-category memory cannot beat in-category baseline. The 'FROM SAVED STYLE' pill IS shown in the header (cd-recs-memory-pill) and the saved theme is highlighted in the all-themes picker, but the top-3 cards still show game_day_scoreboard / game_day_tailgate / game_day_locker. Spec says 'should pre-select the saved theme as Best Match position'. Either: (a) bump memory bias from +35 to >50 in /app/backend/routers/creative_director.py _score_themes, or (b) when useSaved is set on the frontend, surgically swap the saved theme to position 0 in the recs array after fetching from /api/creative-director/recommend.

On the Done step, clicking data-testid='photo-flyer-download-flyer' (an <a href=flyerUrl download onClick={onDownloadClick}> element at PhotoToFlyer.jsx:652-657) does NOT open data-testid='save-style-modal'. Confirmed: menuItem (chicken-wings-12), themeUsed (lastTheme=game_day_scoreboard, different from savedMemory.theme so the early-return at line 955 does NOT fire), askedToSave=false — all preconditions met — yet the modal never appears after the click. Likely cause: the browser begins handling the download navigation in the same tick the React state setter is queued, and the inert <a download> never yields focus back for the modal to paint; OR onDownloadClick is being called but setSaveModal is racing with the download. Recommend: change the <a> to a <button> that programmatically navigator-downloads via fetch+blob OR call e.preventDefault() in onDownloadClick, open the modal, and only trigger window.location = flyerUrl after the modal interaction completes (or in parallel). Either way the modal must paint on click in the same session.

action_items: Fix learning-loop modal: in PhotoToFlyer.jsx around line 569-579, prevent default on the <a download> click, open the save-style-modal, then trigger the download (e.g., via window.location = flyerUrl or a programmatic anchor click) AFTER setSaveModal fires. rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: In /app/backend/routers/creative_director.py _score_themes(), category match adds +50 while memory bias adds only +35. For cross-category memory (saved burger theme + sports-category item), 50 > 35+4=39, so the saved theme can never reach Best Match for cross-category requests. Reproduction: PUT design_memory for 'appetizers::chicken-wings-12' with theme=burger_neon_diner, then POST /api/creative-director/recommend with the same item_key — the response shows game_day_scoreboard at rank=Best Match, not burger_neon_diner. Mitigation: either raise memory bias above the category bonus, or have the frontend swap-to-front when useSaved is active. Bug 2 RCA: PhotoToFlyer.jsx line 652-657 renders Download as <a href=flyerUrl download onClick={onDownloadClick}>. onDownloadClick calls setSaveModal which IS state-setter, but the browser handles the download synchronously (navigation/file save) which likely preempts the React paint of the modal. The state update IS likely queued but the modal never renders visibly. Repro: complete the upload→review→generate flow, click the Download link on Done step — modal does not appear. Mitigation: rewrite Download as <button> + programmatic fetch+blob download OR preventDefault and open the modal first, then trigger the download from inside the modal's onConfirm/onDismiss.
